title: Japanese/English Exchange group ENKAI（縁会）
description:
日本語と英語で話そう！Let's join Japanese/English Exchange group ENKAI（縁会）!

Learn Japanese/English, make friends, learn about culture!All Levels Welcome!Are you looking for opportunities to practice your Japanese or English? Have fun meeting new people while practicing your target language with native speakers. Plus, you get to return the favor and help others reach their goal to become fluent in another language! Not only will you walk away feeling like you've improved your English or Japanese, but you'll also feel great about helping someone else reach his or her goals. Let's enjoy ENKAI!

This event only allows attendees that are 18 years old or older.

Fee: $11 to be paid at the counter (Includes regular flat white, coffee, tea, or a fizzy drink)

title: Build Night: Demos, Collabs & Open Source in Practice
description:
A fortnightly, hands-on session focused on the projects the Auckland AI Collective is actually building — together.

Each session centres on **demonstrations** of what members are working on. Expect live demos, group experiments, and the occasional "let's just try it and see what happens" moment — so come ready to get involved, not just watch. Some parts may invite your participation; none of it is polished or precious.

The tone is **casual and informal**\- eat dinner\, drink\, and enjoy\. This is a place to share ideas\, get feedback\, find collaborators\, and turn "someone should build that" into an actual repo\.

What we cover will vary week to week depending on what people bring and what the group is curious about — the constant is the room: builders comparing notes and starting things together.

**This is for you if** you want to get directly and personally involved in group projects, collaborations, and **open source**.

See what we're already building on GitHub: [https://github.com/auckland-ai-collective](https://github.com/auckland-ai-collective)

Bring a project, a problem, an idea, or just yourself.

After this session we can hang out as long as we like at the restaurant if you want to keep the conversation going and connect with other professionals.

title: AI Self Defense - AI Safety Discussion Group
description:
**Welcome back (or welcome if this is your first time)!**

The AI Safety Discussion group is a place for Aucklanders to discuss AI Safety. All levels of expertise are catered for and welcome :)

This month's topic is **AI Self Defense** — how to protect yourself in a world of AI systems, covering bias from algorithms, legal implications, deepfakes, existential risk, and more.

Our speaker is **Emma Humphrey — organiser of NZ's first AI Safety Conference**. Emma works across the AI Safety and Responsible AI ecosystem in NZ, including delivering AI workshops and training to non-profits through the Nelson AI Sandbox.

Here's what to expect:

**Agenda**

* 6.30 pm kickoff
* 5 min — Group recap for newcomers
* 5 min — AI safety news blast: what happened in the last month
* 15 min — Speaker talk with **Emma Humphrey**
* 30 min — Group discussion

**Tuesday 9th September • 6.30 pm • Rationalist House, 64 Symonds St, Auckland**

Join our discord: [https://discord.gg/8JvxEZSgD](https://discord.gg/8JvxEZSgD)

If you want a head start on AI self defense, pick whatever catches your eye — all of these are short:

Algorithmic bias
\- ProPublica — "Machine Bias" \(the COMPAS story that started the conversation\) — https://www\.propublica\.org/article/machine\-bias\-risk\-assessments\-in\-criminal\-sentencing

Deepfakes & scams
\- AI Incident Database — browse real\-world AI harms\, including deepfake fraud — https://incidentdatabase\.ai
X-risk

\- 80\,000 Hours — Risks from power\-seeking AI \(problem profile — skim the summary\) — https://80000hours\.org/problem\-profiles/artificial\-intelligence/

\- 80\,000 Hours — Catastrophic AI misuse \(problem profile\) — https://80000hours\.org/problem\-profiles/catastrophic\-ai\-misuse/
Local angle

\- Office of the Privacy Commissioner NZ — AI and the Privacy Act guidance — https://www\.privacy\.org\.nz
See you there!

title: On Body and Soul (Hungary 2015, 1 hr 50)
description:
I am really excited about showing this film. It was nominated for the Academy Aaward for Best Foreign Language Film and won the Golden Bear Award at the Berlin International Film Festival.

The film depicts a romance in which two people share a re-occuring dream - that they are a pair of deer in a forest. The film is beautifully shot (you will love deer after this). A lot could be said about this film, but it takes us into world of autism and socially damaged indiividuals

The Fictionmachine reviewer wrote "technically it is superb. Cinematographer Máté Herbai turns every shot into a beautifully composed painting. The film’s use of colour is superb. The scenes of the two deer are remarkable to watch, and capture the animals in such an emotive fashion."

Some won't get it, but nothing new in thw world of cinema there!
